roadmap.scope: ADO Bug #6401. Jira connection URL: a Jira Cloud site URL copied from the browser (https://<site>.atlassian.net/jira/) is reduced to its site root wherever the connector reads it and when a connection is saved; a Data Center URL keeps its context path and that path now actually reaches every request. Frontend: the create-connection wizard shows a failed save, and the Overview tells a system admin that the connection list was refused instead of showing onboarding. All paths under /storage/repos/Lighthouse/.claude/worktrees/spicy-chasing-knuth.
roadmap.goal: Users who paste the Jira Cloud address bar URL (with a /jira/ path) get a working connection on OAuth and API token alike; Data Center context paths work; a failed save or a refused connection list is never shown as 'nothing happened' / 'no connections'.
roadmap.paradigm_note: C# / NUnit 4 in Lighthouse.Backend.Tests; Vitest + RTL in Lighthouse.Frontend. No DISTILL wave for a bugfix: RED is a crafter-authored regression test through the driving port (IWorkTrackingConnector.ValidateConnection / request URIs seen by the injected HttpMessageHandler; controller actions; rendered components), failing on today's code for the bug's reason before production code changes.

validation.reviewer: orchestrator (inline, following the bug-6306 / bug-6254 precedent for a surgical bugfix)
validation.notes: No architect dispatch: the Phase-1 RCA (nw-troubleshooter, 2026-10-23, docs/feature/fix-jira-cloud-url-path/rca.md, approved by the maintainer) prescribes every fix site. Steps/files ratio 4/9.

user_decisions: Maintainer approved the RCA and the fix direction (2026-10-23).
Fix Data Center context paths too (client BaseAddress keeps the path); call it out in the release notes.
Include save-time normalisation (Create, Validate and Update of a Jira connection).

Approved UI sketches: (a) wizard step 3 shows an error Alert (severity error) when Create fails, stays on the step, does not call onComplete; (b) Overview: a system admin whose connection list returned 403 sees a warning Alert "You don't have access to the connections list. Ask a Lighthouse administrator to check your roles." instead of the onboarding stepper.
Go ahead without waiting for the reporter's HAR / request log.
out_of_scope: Custom Cloud domains (not *.atlassian.net) are left as entered.
Frontend-side URL normalisation (the rule lives in the backend only).
Migrating already-stored URLs (read-time normalisation covers them; expand-only migrations).
Moving OverviewDashboard to TanStack Query or adding an error state to useRbac.

phases.name: Backend: one canonical Jira site address
phases.description: Regression tests through the connector and the connection controllers, then the minimal fix.

steps.name: The connector uses the site root of a Jira Cloud URL and keeps a Data Center context path
steps.description: A new JiraSiteAddress reduces *.atlassian.net URLs to scheme+host and trims one trailing slash otherwise; every connector read of the Url option goes through it; the HTTP client base address ends in '/' so a DC context path survives; the OAuth cloud-id lookup uses the injectable test handler and names the expected URL form when the site answers with a non-JSON page.
steps.scenario_name: A Jira Cloud URL with a /jira/ path validates against the site root on API token and OAuth; a Data Center context path reaches every request
red_to_green_tests: JiraSiteAddressTest :: https://x.atlassian.net/jira/ -> https://x.atlassian.net; https://X.Atlassian.net/jira/software/projects -> https://X.Atlassian.net; https://host/jira and https://host/jira/ -> https://host/jira; https://host/ -> https://host; malformed input returned unchanged
connector (handler-backed) :: API token + https://x.atlassian.net/jira/ -> request to https://x.atlassian.net/rest/api/2/myself (or whichever validate route is used)
connector (handler-backed) :: Data Center https://host/jira -> request to https://host/jira/rest/... (fails today: path is dropped)

connector (handler-backed) :: OAuth + https://x.atlassian.net/jira/ -> tenant_info requested at https://x.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info (fails today: /jira/_edge/tenant_info, and the lookup bypasses the handler)

connector (handler-backed) :: OAuth, tenant_info answers 200 text/html -> validation is invalid with a message naming the expected form "Use your site address, e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net" (not the generic unexpected-error verdict)
criteria: RED captured before production changes: the DC context-path, OAuth tenant_info URL and non-JSON-message tests fail on today's code for the bug's reason.

JiraSiteAddress.Of(string): trim; Uri.TryCreate absolute; host ends with .atlassian.net (case-insensitive) -> scheme://host (host casing preserved, port kept if non-default); otherwise the input with one trailing '/' trimmed; non-absolute/malformed input returned unchanged so the existing invalid_url verdict still fires.

Every read of the Url option inside JiraWorkTrackingConnector (validate guard area, browse link, gateway cloud-id, direct BaseAddress + client cache key, DeploymentCache keys) goes through one private helper using JiraSiteAddress; no ad-hoc TrimEnd('/') of the Url remains.
The direct client BaseAddress ends with '/'; relative routes (JiraRestRoutes) are unchanged, so Cloud request URIs are byte-identical to today for a clean site URL.

ResolveCloudIdAsync uses _httpMessageHandlerForTesting when set (same pattern as GetOrCreateClient) and a non-JSON tenant_info answer yields an invalid verdict whose user message is "Use your site address, e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net".
No live Jira: tests use the injected handler only; JiraWorkTrackingConnectorTest.cs (Integration/JiraIntegration) is not touched.
dotnet build zero warnings; dotnet test with the standard live-connector exclusion filter green.
steps.implementation_notes: Pre-apply docs/ci-learnings.md (CA1861 static readonly arrays for TestCase data, CA1859, etc.). Prefer [TestCase] over duplicated tests. No comments citing the bug number or internal ids. Commit: fix(jira): use the site root of a Jira Cloud URL and keep a Data Center context path (bug 6401)

steps.name: A Jira connection is saved with its canonical site address
steps.description: Create, Validate and Update of a Jira connection store the Url option as JiraSiteAddress.Of(raw); other systems' options are untouched.
steps.scenario_name: Creating or updating a Jira connection with https://x.atlassian.net/jira/ stores https://x.atlassian.net
red_to_green_tests: WorkTrackingSystemConnectionsControllerTest :: Create with a Jira Url https://x.atlassian.net/jira/ persists https://x.atlassian.net
WorkTrackingSystemConnectionsControllerTest :: Validate passes the canonical Url to the connector
WorkTrackingSystemConnectionControllerTest :: Update with a Jira Url https://x.atlassian.net/jira/ persists https://x.atlassian.net
a non-Jira connection's Url option is stored as entered; a Jira DC Url https://host/jira/ is stored as https://host/jira
criteria: RED captured: the Create and Update tests fail on the 01-01 code (raw URL stored).

The canonicalisation is applied in exactly one place per save path (CreateConnectionFromDto shared by Create+Validate; the Update action), keyed on WorkTrackingSystem == Jira and JiraWorkTrackingOptionNames.Url; reuse JiraSiteAddress, do not duplicate the rule.
If both controllers need the same rewrite, extract one shared helper rather than two copies.
Existing controller tests stay green; dotnet build zero warnings; dotnet test (standard exclusion filter) green.
steps.implementation_notes: Commit: fix(jira): save a Jira connection with its site address (bug 6401)

phases.name: Frontend: a failed save or a refused list is visible
phases.description: Wizard save error on step 3; Overview refused alert for a system admin.

steps.name: The create-connection wizard shows a failed save
steps.description: handleCreate catches a rejected save the same way handleNext does and the existing error Alert renders on step 3.
steps.scenario_name: When saving the connection fails, step 3 shows the error and the wizard does not complete
red_to_green_tests: CreateConnectionWizard.test :: save rejects with an ApiError -> an alert with its message is visible on step 3; onComplete not called; Create button usable again
CreateConnectionWizard.test :: save rejects with a plain Error -> a fallback error message is visible on step 3
criteria: RED captured: the test fails on today's code (no alert on step 3 / unhandled rejection).
Reuse the existing error state and Alert markup from step 2 (extract a small render helper if both steps need it); copy mirrors handleNext's message + technicalDetails handling.
Any user-facing fallback copy uses configurable terminology where a renamable term appears.
pnpm test green; pnpm build zero errors/warnings (Biome clean). Note: prebuild runs biome check --write; remove any */docs symlinks first if present.
steps.implementation_notes: Commit: fix(connections): show why saving a new connection failed (bug 6401)

steps.name: The Overview says the connection list was refused instead of showing onboarding
steps.description: When the connections request returns 403 for a user useRbac() reports as system admin, render a warning Alert in place of the onboarding stepper; genuine non-admins keep today's behaviour.
steps.scenario_name: A system admin whose connection list is refused sees that access was refused, not onboarding
red_to_green_tests: OverviewDashboard.test :: system admin + connections 403 -> alert "You don't have access to the connections list. Ask a Lighthouse administrator to check your roles." is shown and the onboarding stepper is absent
OverviewDashboard.test :: non-admin + connections 403 -> behaviour unchanged (existing no-access handling, no new alert)
OverviewDashboard.test :: system admin + connections 200 [] -> onboarding stepper still shown
criteria: RED captured: the system-admin 403 test fails on today's code (stepper shown).
RBAC state comes only from useRbac(); no direct fetch of /api/latest/authorization/my-summary.
Alert uses MUI Alert severity="warning" with the approved copy; keep showRbacNoAccessAlert behaviour for non-admins.
pnpm test green; pnpm build zero errors/warnings.
